# Welcome: bring a real scientific problem / 欢迎：带一个真实科学问题来

Bring a real scientific problem. You do not need to understand the internal Core/OAC architecture before participating. Write in Chinese or English; either is sufficient.

带一个真实科学问题来即可。参与之前不需要先理解项目内部的 Core/OAC 架构。可使用中文或英文，任一语言均可。

Try it on a real problem and tell us where it fails.

用一个真实问题测试它，然后告诉我们它在哪里失败。

Start a [Research Problem](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/discussions/new?category=general) (currently in General) with your question, observations, and available evidence. A tentative claim or incomplete formulation is welcome. Use [Discussions](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/discussions) for open examination, [Issues](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/issues/new/choose) for reproducible failures or concrete work, and the [Casebook](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/blob/main/cases/README.md) to preserve mature cases.

带上问题、观测与已有证据，提交 [Research Problem 科学问题](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/discussions/new?category=general)（目前位于 General 分类）。欢迎暂定 claim 和尚不完整的 formulation。[Discussions](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/discussions) 用于开放审查，[Issues](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/issues/new/choose) 用于可复现 failure 或具体工作，[Casebook](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/blob/main/cases/README.md) 用于沉淀成熟案例。

Contributions include / 以下都属于贡献：

- Providing a real scientific case / 提供真实科学案例。
- Identifying a bad formulation / 指出 formulation 错误。
- Constructing a counterexample / 构造反例。
- Reproducing a failure / 复现 failure。
- Identifying excessive skepticism or premature stopping / 指出过度怀疑或过早停止。
- Offering domain expertise / 提供领域知识。
- Proposing a minimal repair / 提出最小修复。
- Contributing a PR / 提交 PR。

Share only material you may publish. Useful critique should identify the scientific issue and the evidence or conditions that would resolve it; a complete derivation or benchmark is not required.

请只分享有权公开的材料。有用的审查可指出科学问题，以及能够解决它的证据或条件；不要求完整推导或 benchmark。

Substantive contributions may be credited in case records, release notes, contributor history, or relevant documentation according to actual contribution. This does not promise academic paper authorship or automatic maintainer status.

实质性贡献可按实际贡献在案例记录、发布说明、贡献历史或相关文档中署名或致谢；不承诺论文作者资格或自动授予维护者身份。

[Contribution guidance](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) / [参与贡献](https://github.com/ZWY-research/physics-to-math-research/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)
